stem.text: Which row is correct about the structure of proteins?

A.text: determined by the sequence of DNA nucleotides; occurs by hydrogen bonding between NH and C=O groups of amino acids; disulfide, ionic, hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions are all involved; always formed by association of two or more polypeptides

B.text: the number of amino acids in each polypeptide chain; in a single polypeptide it is either an $\alpha$-helix or a $\beta$-pleated sheet; the bonds are formed at specific points determined by the primary structure; always formed by two or more polypeptides held together by bonds formed between the polypeptides

C.text: formed by twenty different amino acids linked in a specific order; an $\alpha$-helix is formed by hydrogen bonds between side chains of amino acids; only globular proteins have this level of structure; always formed by two or more different polypeptides to give the final shape

D.text: the sequence of amino acids in each polypeptide chain; a $\beta$-pleated sheet is the result of a folded polypeptide forming hydrogen bonds between adjacent strands; reactions between side chains of specific amino acids give a specific 3-D shape; always formed by two or more polypeptides and a metal ion
